node.statement: Cohomological Kunneth isomorphism over R: for CW complexes X and Y with each H^k(Y;R) a finitely generated free R-module, the cross product H*(X;R) (x)_R H*(Y;R) -> H*(X x Y;R) is an isomorphism of rings; in particular this holds over the field R = reals for finite-CW spaces with finite-dimensional cohomology.
node.author: orchestrator
